svg.text: Photographed ESP32 30-pin board • Revision B • No secure element • Hardware set 1 only
Use the large micro-USB ESP32 board. GPS: regulated 5 V breakout input. Fit BZ1 only after verifying its 5 V / 20 mA rating.
USB_5V = VIN rail; measure with USB connected.
Use USB as the only board power source.
VGPS = USB_5V to GY-NEO6MV2 VCC input.
Onboard regulator supplies the 3.3 V GPS chip.
Never apply 5 V to the bare GPS chip or GPIO.
D1 / D2 / D3 Three status indicators
Anode toward resistor; cathode toward GND.
Reference: rated 5 V active buzzer, ≤20 mA. Verify your existing sounder first.
Check E / B / C package pinout
Optional C1/C2: 100 nF from each button input to GND. R1/R2 pull-ups remain fitted; debounce is also required in firmware.
VBUZZ = verified USB_5V only for the specified 5 V sounder. All GND symbols are connected. No vehicle power connection.
GPS: UART2, 9600 8N1 initially; RX2 / GPIO16 receives GPS TX. ANT1 connects only to GPS. Indoors use simulated position.
The existing firmware still needs GPS, long-press handling and this buzzer driver added. Circuit not physically tested.
Companion specification: MAIN_UNIT_DESIGN.md • Pin-level netlist: main-unit-netlist.csv • No Nano/Uno inside this unit.
